releases.title: 212NYC New York's Digital Advertising Club Celebrates Industry Trailblazers at 12th Annual Gala on Nov. 5, 2026
releases.body:
212NYC 2026 Gala Awards Spotlight "Humanity in Action: Staying Human in the Age of AI" 

NEW YORK, Nov. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Nearly 300 of the advertising industry's most influential leaders, innovators, and changemakers gathered at Tribeca Rooftop on November 5 for 212NYC's 12th Annual Gala & Excellence Awards.

212NYC, New York's Digital Advertising Club, hosted the evening under the theme "Humanity in Action: Staying Human in the Age of AI," reflecting a pivotal moment for the industry as leaders navigate the opportunities and challenges of artificial intelligence while keeping human creativity, connection, and impact at the center. Each year, the 212NYC Gala brings together the brightest talent and most influential voices in advertising to celebrate the trailblazers, visionaries, and innovators driving the industry forward and making a lasting impact.

"The 212NYC Gala gives us an opportunity to celebrate the people moving our industry forward," said Jay Wolff, President of 212NYC. "As AI transforms how we work, connect, and create, this year's theme is a powerful reminder that our greatest asset remains our humanity. The leaders we're honoring exemplify the vision, innovation, and human impact that will define the next chapter of advertising."

The 212NYC Annual Gala is a signature gathering for the New York advertising community, bringing together leaders across media, marketing, and advertising to celebrate achievement, strengthen connections, and explore the forces shaping the industry's future.

"Since 2002, 212NYC has grown alongside the digital advertising industry, bringing people together to learn, exchange ideas, and build meaningful relationships," said Ritu Trivedi, Vice President of 212NYC. "Our community has always been driven by a willingness to embrace change while recognizing the value of human connection. This year's Gala celebrates that spirit and the people who are helping our industry innovate with purpose."

The 2026 Gala recognized five distinguished leaders whose work exemplifies this year's commitment to humanity, innovation, and impact.

The 2026 Honorees:

  • Chrissie Hanson, CEO, dentsu North America Media Practice & Global Brand President, Carat (Human-Centered Leadership Award)
  • Todd Kaplan, CMO North America, The Kraft Heinz Company (Industry Luminary Award)
  • Jeff Lucas, Chief Revenue Officer, Tubi (Breakthrough Leader Award)
  • Kory Marchisotto, President, e.l.f. Brands (Human Impact Award)
  • Nick Tran, President & CMO, First Round Collective (Innovation with Impact Award)

The evening featured keynote remarks and hosting by Rishad Tobaccowala, 212NYC's 2025 Industry Luminary Award honoree. A respected industry thinker and leader, Tobaccowala returned to this year's event to share his perspective on the evolving advertising landscape and the importance of keeping people at the heart of progress.

"We are living through a period of extraordinary technological change, but technology alone cannot determine the future we create," said Rishad Tobaccowala, keynote speaker and host of the 2026 212NYC Gala. "The real opportunity is to use AI to amplify human imagination, judgment, and connection, not replace them. I'm delighted to return to the 212NYC Gala, where this year's theme invites our industry to think deeply about what it means to innovate while staying human."

The evening was made possible through the generous support of its sponsors, including Acast, Amazon Ads, Channel Factory x Omnicom Media, CÎROC Vodka, dentsu, DoubleVerify, e.l.f. Beauty, Fanatics Advertising, Fetch, Fox, Google, iHeartMedia, Instacart Ads, Integral Ad Science, Kraft Heinz, LoopMe, Media.net, The New York Times, Peer39, Raptive, Roku, Skydance Advertising, Tubi, Vevo, Walmart Connect, WPP Media, and Zynga Ads.

 About 212NYC, New York's Digital Advertising Club

212NYC is New York's leading organization for the digital advertising industry, reaching more than 5,000 professionals across media, marketing, and advertising. 212NYC connects and educates community members through a year-round slate of compelling panels with industry leaders, signature events, and programs that advance learning and drive impact. A nonprofit, volunteer-run organization, 212NYC welcomes advertising professionals throughout the New York area. Learn more at www.212NYC.org.

releases.title: Causal Launches Causal ONE, a New Intelligence Platform Connecting Audience Discovery and Media Planning
releases.body:
New platform helps marketers challenge audience assumptions, uncover growth opportunities, and translate insights into strategic media recommendations

LOS ANGELES, Nov. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Causal, an award-winning provider of advanced digital advertising solutions, today announced the launch of Causal ONE, an intelligence platform designed to transform how marketers approach audience discovery and media planning.

Causal ONE brings brand intelligence, audience discovery, media strategy, and creative inspiration together in one connected experience. Starting with a brand's website, business objectives, geographic priorities, and targeting inputs, the platform combines brand research with Causal's performance data and benchmarking capabilities to identify relevant audiences and uncover opportunities that may otherwise go unexplored.

"Causal ONE represents an important step forward for our business and how we help clients approach audience strategy," said Farshad Fardad, CEO of Causal. "We built it to challenge conventional thinking about audiences and give our teams and clients a more connected way to move from brand understanding to new opportunities. It brings together the expertise and innovation our teams have developed over the past two years in a single experience."

At the center of Causal ONE are Audience Blueprints, which provide a deeper understanding of potential audiences by explaining the signals behind them, what makes them distinct, and how they could be reached. Rather than stopping at audience identification, the platform enables users to prioritize audiences, explore channel opportunities, and connect those decisions in a strategic media plan.

Causal ONE also incorporates illustrative creative concepts, helping teams visualize potential campaign directions and make emerging strategies more tangible. By connecting audience intelligence with media recommendations and creative exploration, the platform gives marketers a more informed starting point for evaluating opportunities and developing activation strategies.

The initial experience was designed to bring greater value to the early stages of the media planning process, equipping Causal's teams with a research-led foundation for client conversations. Additional analytical capabilities extend the experience through pixel-based audience insights, live business data, and period-over-period reporting, providing further context for ongoing analysis and planning.

"As a media planner, what I love about the platform is how beautifully it brings together human expertise and agentic technology," said Shana Atwood, Vice President of Strategic Planning. "By turning our proprietary data into an intelligent starting point, we can get to recommendations faster, giving our teams more time to apply the context and nuance that technology can't replicate. Tech makes the recommendation faster and better, our people make it meaningful."

Developed through collaboration across Causal's technology, decision science, media planning, partnerships, and other teams, Causal ONE reflects the company's continued investment in connecting its capabilities into a more cohesive approach to audience intelligence and activation.

With Causal ONE, marketers can move beyond familiar audience definitions, explore new possibilities, and connect those discoveries to strategic media decisions.

To learn more about Causal ONE, visit causaliq.com/one

About Causal 

Causal is a leading programmatic audience development and activation solution. With a focus on innovation and data-driven strategies, Causal empowers the world's leading advertisers to reimagine audiences while exceeding media performance objectives. By leveraging unique data points and optimization methodology, Causal brings a human approach to data science and campaign activation. 

To learn more, visit causaliq.com

releases.title: Cuttable Unveils Next-Generation AI Advertising Platform as U.S. Expansion Accelerates
releases.body:
The platform's evolution comes alongside an A$20 million Series A funding round led by Airtree Ventures, marking Cuttable's next phase of growth as it moves beyond AI ad generation.

NEW YORK, Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cuttable, an AI-powered creative production platform for performance marketing teams, today unveiled the next evolution of its platform, designed to help brands move beyond generating ads to understand what works and make smarter decisions about what to create next. Just one year after entering the U.S. market, the Australian-founded company now generates 40% of its revenue from the region.

While AI has made producing ads faster and easier, knowing which creative to make next remains a challenge. Most tools focus on either generating ads or analyzing their performance, leaving marketers to connect the dots between what they intend to test, what actually worked and what to create next.

Cuttable brings those pieces together. Its evolved platform connects a brand's creative assets, customer data and performance history with the marketer's original intent, building on what the brand has already tried rather than starting from scratch with each new creative brief.

Cuttable's software was built to remove creative as a bottleneck for performance marketing teams producing, testing and rebuilding ads at scale. The platform reads a brand's website, social channels and guidelines to build an editable brand strategy and brand kit. From there, marketers can write a brief in plain language and receive finished, editable ads, built using existing brand and product assets or Cuttable's AI content studio, Shoots, which creates and extends photo and video content.

Finished ads publish directly to Meta Ads Manager, and Cuttable's Ad Insights reads the performance back from Meta, including thumbstop, click-through rate and return on ad spend, so that the next brief builds on what worked. It's this continuous feedback loop, rather than creative generation alone, that differentiates Cuttable from tools that separately generate ads or report on performance. 

Cuttable's Co-founder & CEO, Sam Kroonenburg, who previously founded and sold A Cloud Guru in 2021, said, "Creative is still made the way it was thirty years ago, one ad at a time. Making an ad has never been the hard part, it is knowing which one to make next. We are building the creative production system ecommerce performance marketers have been waiting for."

Across 280,000 ads and more than $320 million in Meta spend run through its platform, Cuttable found that one ad in eleven returns ten times its spend or better, and that a small number of ads end up carrying an entire account. The company's data also shows brands increase creative output 3.4 times going into November, underscoring the growing pressure to produce and test ads at scale.

In just two years since launching, Cuttable now works with more than 420 brands across the United States, Australia, New Zealand, Asia and Europe, including lululemon, Rodan & Fields and Brick. Brands on the platform average a 4.4 times return on ad spend and see a 37 percent lift in account-level return on ad spend after moving to Cuttable. To support its growing U.S. business, Cuttable is actively hiring and building out its San Francisco team.

Airtree, which first invested in Cuttable earlier this year, returned to lead the round. One of Australia's largest technology investors, its portfolio includes Canva, Airwallex, Linktree and SafetyCulture.

Airtree Ventures partner James Cameron, whose firm also backed A Cloud Guru, said: "Since we backed Cuttable's seed round, their growth has been much faster than our (already very high) expectations. The world of ad creative is being turned on its head by AI, and we're excited to lead this round as Cuttable becomes the leading system that performance marketers reach for to make content work harder."

With the U.S. already emerging as a major growth market, Cuttable plans to use its latest funding to accelerate its expansion and advance the next evolution of its platform. Cuttable's focus from here is on closing the creative loop, helping marketers decide what to make next rather than only how to make it.

ABOUT CUTTABLE

Cuttable is a creative production platform for performance marketing teams, used by more than 420 brands across the United States, Australia, New Zealand, Asia and Europe. The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Melbourne and San Francisco.

To learn more, visit cuttable.com.

releases.title: Guideline Ends the Media Plan Re-Entry Bottleneck with Launch of New AI Ingestion Agent
releases.body:
The new agent reads media plan spreadsheets in any format and turns them into clean, governed data in seconds.

NEW YORK, Oct. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Guideline, a global provider of ad intelligence and media plan management solutions, today launched the AI Ingestion Agent in its Media Plan Management platform. The agent takes the spreadsheet media plans agencies and brands already use and turns them into structured, governed data in seconds.

Most media plans still start in a spreadsheet, and every agency, team, market and client lays them out differently. Getting a plan into a system of record has meant re-entering it by hand, which takes time, introduces errors, and delays the moment when finance, leadership and operations teams can see and act on the plan. The AI Ingestion Agent removes that manual step without requiring teams to change how they build plans.

With the AI Ingestion Agent, planning teams can:

  • Start from their existing file. Upload an Excel or CSV file to create a new plan.
  • Automate field mapping. The agent reads each column and suggests how it maps to the customer's plan templates and fields.
  • Review before anything is saved. Fields the agent is less certain about are flagged, and nothing is committed until the planner confirms it.
  • Use the plan right away. Once confirmed, the plan is structured data that can be used for reporting, budget tracking and actuals reconciliation.

Uploaded files are validated so that only supported plan formats are processed, and customer plan data is not used to train AI models. Each upload is saved as a new plan version rather than overwriting earlier work, so every change can be traced. This new product capability ships with enterprise controls. It is opt-in and enabled per customer. This first release creates new plans from spreadsheets; updating existing plans and bulk-importing historical ones will follow.

"Every customer's spreadsheet looks different, and for years that has been the hardest part of getting plans into a system of record," said Vincent Mifsud, Chief Executive Officer at Guideline. "The sooner a plan becomes governed data, the sooner it can be measured, reconciled and improved. That is central to making Media Plan Management the trusted source of truth for the more than $300 billion in media budgets our customers manage with us."

"Planners shouldn't have to retype a plan to get it into a governed platform," said Steve Silvers, Chief Product Officer at Guideline. "The agent works with the files teams already use and handles the mapping for them. We built it to save planners time without taking decisions out of their hands."

Availability: The AI Ingestion Agent is available now for enterprise customers. To learn more or schedule a demo, contact sales@guideline.ai or visit www.guideline.ai.

About Guideline

Guideline is a global provider of ad intelligence and media plan management technology for the world's leading brands, agencies, media owners and investors. Its solutions help enterprises understand advertising markets, manage media plans and make more informed decisions across the buying and selling ecosystem. Guideline's media plan management solutions support more than $300 billion in managed media budgets across more than 60,000 active media plans and 10,000+ monthly users. Its proprietary spend and pricing data represents approximately $200 billion in annual media investment across 65 countries worldwide.

For more information, visit www.guideline.ai.

releases.title: OMNICOM MEDIA AND REMBRAND PARTNER TO SCALE IN-CONTENT ADVERTISING ACROSS PREMIUM STREAMING
releases.body:
First-to-market capability brings together Acxiom, Omni, and Rembrand's VISTA platform, with access to premium inventory from major media partners

NEW YORK, Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Omnicom Media, an Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) Connected Capability, and in-content advertising platform Rembrand are partnering to bring in-content advertising into the mainstream media mix with a first-to-market capability that enables brands to identify, plan, and activate in-content placements across first-look premium streaming inventory from multiple major media companies.

The partnership provides OM's Content Collective – the group's branded content center of excellence - first-mover access to Rembrand's AI-powered VISTA platform, which scans publisher content to identify scenes that can be monetized by insertion of in-content advertising. Using AcxiomRealID™ and direct integrations with major streamers, brands can identify the most relevant content for a given audience. Pairing this intelligence with Rembrand's VISTA platform, brands unlock a more systematic and scalable way to find relevant programming and activate against those opportunities across participating streaming partners.

Historically, in-content advertising has been managed through bespoke partnerships and individual content integrations. The new capability brings those opportunities into a common planning framework, giving media teams visibility across participating publishers and allowing in-content placements to be considered alongside broader media investments.

The collaboration is rooted in a fundamental shift in consumer behavior. Omnicom Media's recent research, From Tuned Out to Leaned In: How to Combat Ad Avoidance, found that 65% of U.S. consumers avoid advertising to some degree, whether by skipping, scrolling, muting, or ignoring ads. As consumers use subscriptions, apps, AI, and other tools to exert greater control over their media experiences, brands need new ways to reach people without creating another interruption.

Additionally, commissioned research conducted by Omnicom Media's Partner Intelligence team in collaboration with Rembrand evaluated the effectiveness of in-content advertising, finding that, when paired with traditional video ads, perceptions of premium content amplify the performance of ICAs, driving a 5.5 times impact on message recall, and a 4x increase in both purchase intent and perceptions of the brand as premium.

"Our research identified how quickly consumers actively or passively disengage when advertising feels intrusive or overly repetitive," said Megan Pagliuca, Chief Product Officer, Omnicom Media. "To address this, we have launched new capabilities in streaming to address negative reach, improve relevance and measurability of traditional brand experiences, and now we are complementing these with a first of its kind data driven, scalable approach to in-content advertising."

How It Works

The capability connects four stages:

  • Audience matching: Acxiom audience segments are matched with streaming viewership data to identify shows, movies, and genres that best index with a target audience.
  • Inventory mapping: Relevant programming is matched against in-content advertising opportunities available through VISTA.
  • Inventory expansion: Additional content can be onboarded through established processes with participating streaming partners when relevant opportunities are not yet available.
  • Activation: Brands deploy in-content placements against selected audiences and programming across participating publishers.

The result is a way to put brands directly into content consumers have chosen to watch, while providing greater visibility into in-content supply across publishers.

"In-content advertising has always offered brands the opportunity to show up within content people have actively chosen to watch," said John Sedlak, Chief Revenue Officer, Rembrand. "Our collaboration with Omnicom Media makes those opportunities easier to identify, plan and activate across premium streaming, bringing a new level of scale and consistency to the category."

Applications range from an automaker placing a new model in relevant programming across a streamer, using Acxiom in-market auto segments to reach shoppers who routinely avoid traditional ads, to a beverage brand appearing in top-indexing summer programming during key seasonal purchase periods. Retail brands can similarly use in-content placements to directly connect exposure to the path to purchase.

Summing up the response to-date from clients who have been briefed on the new capability, Jillian Davis, Director of Marketing Technology for Auto Trader and Kelly Blue Book parent company Cox Automotive said, "We're always eager to leverage new, scalable and organic ways to reach our customers within premium content."

CONTACT:  isabelle.gauvry@omc.com

ABOUT OMNICOM MEDIA

Omnicom Media, an Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) Connected Capability, is the world's largest global media management network. Powered by the Omni Intelligence Platform, Omnicom Media agencies leverage $75.6 billion in billings, 47,000+ specialists across 70+ markets, and the industry's most powerful portfolio identity, commerce, and intelligence assets to design dynamic Growth Ecosystems that enable the world's most ambitious businesses to grow faster and smarter. The Omnicom Media portfolio includes global media agency brands OMD, PHD, Initiative, Hearts United and UM; core Omnicom Integrated Media offerings Acxiom, the world's premier identity solution, and the Flywheel end-to-end commerce solution; and specialty services across the cloud consulting, creator, financial, healthcare, and sports & entertainment categories.  For more information visit omnicommedia.com

Rembrand is the leading In-Content Advertising platform, using AI to seamlessly integrate brands into video content. The company's technology provides a non-intrusive and engaging advertising experience for viewers while delivering increased brand awareness and improved engagement for advertisers. Rembrand works with a vast network of global content owners and media companies to deliver unparalleled reach and scale for its brand partners.  For more info, visit www.rembrand.com.

As a boutique specialist, V2 has spent two decades leveraging best-in-class enterprise platforms to engineer data pipelines, optimize complex technology ecosystems, and guide Revenue Operations teams through multi-platform transformations. V2's Databricks practice answers a clear mandate: Accelerating Revenue Operations and Architecting Solutions for Media and Ad Sales, powered by Data, Analytics, and AI. In practice, this means helping clients consolidate fragmented data estates, build scalable analytics layers that surface actionable insights, and deploy AI features that augment the way revenue teams price, forecast, and activate.

V2's solutions built on the Databricks Data + AI Platform address the full spectrum of Revenue Operations complexity, from unifying siloed ad systems and CRM data into a coherent intelligence layer to building predictive models that inform financial and campaign performance. The result is a tighter feedback loop between data and revenue: faster decisions, fewer blind spots, and materially better outcomes for clients and their advertisers.

"Twenty years ago, we founded V2 on the premise that velocity and voltage, speed and energy, define how great organizations move," says John Tanner, Founder and CEO of V2 Strategic Advisors. "Our Databricks practice is the fullest expression of that premise yet. We're taking two decades of media and ad sales expertise and running it through one of the most powerful data and AI platforms on the market. For Revenue Operations teams ready to transform, the timing has never been better."

Why Databricks. Why V2. Why Now.

Databricks, the data and AI company, is the defining platform for enterprises looking to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics, and agents. For media and ad sales organizations, where data volume is high and decisioning cycles are short, that capability creates a competitive advantage.

As the consulting landscape shifts toward AI-native operations, V2's Databricks practice represents a deliberate choice: the firms that will define this next era are those that combine enterprise-grade technical capability with true subject-matter authority.

"Solving complex challenges in media has always given us a competitive edge that transcends any single platform," says Joe Hooper, SVP of Architecture, Data & Analytics at V2. "Our Databricks practice doesn't just add a new tool to our kit; it gives our clients a new category of capability, grounded in our deep experience with media and ad sales organizations, and aimed squarely at what they need now." releases.title: Kargo Launches Karlo, Opening Agentic Media Buying to Smaller Teams and Businesses
releases.body:
Karlo brings connected video and cross-platform campaign capabilities that previously required enterprise-scale budgets and teams to a wider set of advertisers

NEW YORK, Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Kargo today announced the general availability of Karlo, a self-serve agentic media buying platform built for smaller teams and businesses. Karlo gives smaller teams and businesses direct access to the same creative and media technology Kargo has built over two decades, in a simplified, self-serve format designed for their size and speed.

Karlo is powered by two core technologies: Creative Science®, grounded in decades of Kargo's proprietary cross-platform performance data, and Media Intelligence, which combines premium audience data with Kargo's contextual signals. Smaller teams can use the platform to plan, create, and activate campaigns across the open web, CTV, and social from one system, bringing Karlo's "One Platform. Every Screen." approach to a wider set of advertisers.

Karlo gives smaller businesses a way to run connected video campaigns that previously required enterprise-scale budgets and staff. Setup takes minutes, campaigns can be launched and adjusted, and reporting lives in one place, all from a single self-serve platform.

"Most of the agentic tools launching right now are built around bidding and targeting, functions that were already pretty well-automated," said Harry Kargman, founder and CEO of Kargo. "Creative usually sits outside that loop, untouched, even though it's the biggest lever on performance. Karlo takes the creative a business already has and incorporates it into decision-making, scoring, and adjustments, alongside targeting and bidding, in real time. Smaller teams get the same advantage our biggest clients have had for years, without needing the budget or staff they'd normally need to get there."

In a campaign with the Ad Council for its "Love, Your Mind" mental health initiative, Karlo was used to reach adults who tend to disengage from traditional mental health messaging. The campaign drove a 21% lift in ad recall and a 10% lift in aided awareness.

Karlo takes a different approach: instead of setting up separate buys, often with multiple buyers, for CTV, social, and the open web, the platform brings all three into one flow built around a single audience target. It evaluates creative performance alongside media decisions and uses the results to improve campaigns while they're running, so advertisers don't need a dedicated analyst to monitor the account.

Smaller teams can start with existing marketing or briefing documents, or use natural-language prompts to set campaign goals, build audiences, and manage campaigns without learning the workflows of multiple buying platforms. Karlo's contextual technology helps determine where and when ads should appear based on what people are engaging with, adding another layer beyond traditional audience segments and giving smaller advertisers a level of targeting precision usually reserved for bigger budgets.

"Karlo gave us an innovative way to meaningfully engage an audience that can truly benefit from mental health messaging and resources," said DJ Perera, chief media officer at the Ad Council. "This partnership is a powerful example of how the Ad Council's Mental Health Initiative leverages the best of marketing, media, and AI technology to improve mental health outcomes for those who are struggling."

Karlo is available today. To learn more, visit karlo.com.

About Kargo

Kargo is an advertising platform that brings creative and premium media together to improve performance across screens. We combine high-impact creative with precision targeting and 100% premium inventory across CTV, social, the open web, and retail media. Our proprietary AI and Creative Science® technology power that combination, helping brands drive measurable, full-funnel results while simplifying execution. Founded in 2003, Kargo is a global company headquartered in New York, with offices across the US, APAC, and Europe.

kargo@ssmandl.com

releases.title: Horizon Commerce and Pacvue Expand Strategic Partnership to Connect Retail Media Planning, Activation and Measurement
releases.body:
Expanded partnership brings together Horizon Commerce's strategy and activation expertise with Pacvue's Commerce Media Operating System to help marketers move from insight to outcomes faster

NEW YORK, Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Horizon Commerce, Horizon Media Holdings' specialist agency for commerce and digital experience, and Pacvue, the leading AI-Powered Commerce Media Operating System, today announced an expanded strategic partnership designed to help advertisers more effectively connect retail media planning, activation and measurement. The expanded relationship brings Horizon Commerce's Strategy and Activation teams, including its Blu Commerce intelligence capabilities, closer to Pacvue's Commerce Media Operating System, enabling a more integrated workflow across planning, activation and measurement on major retail media platforms.

The partnership addresses a persistent challenge for marketers: the systems used to measure media performance and determine investment strategy are often disconnected from the platforms used by teams to execute campaigns. As a result, marketers can identify an opportunity through measurement but are forced to rely on manual processes, separate taxonomies and retailer-specific metrics to translate that insight into action.

Blu Commerce provides a standardized view of retail media performance across retailers, products and media tactics, including measurement of incremental contribution and iROI. Pacvue unifies that intelligence with other proprietary omnicommerce signals to power media activation, giving Horizon Commerce's Strategy and Activation teams one platform to translate those insights into investment decisions and activation strategies across major retail media networks.

Blu Commerce and Pacvue's technology works in lockstep, feeding performance back into the next cycle of planning and optimization. Pacvue's real-time commerce signals – including availability, pricing, and content health – keep activation aligned with what's happening on the digital shelf. The result is a common decision framework connecting senior marketing leadership and campaign practitioners, helping brands allocate investment more effectively, reduce inefficient spend and drive greater incremental sales.

"Retail media has no shortage of data. The harder problem is turning that data into a consistent investment decision," said Katie Comerford, President of Horizon Commerce. "A brand may be operating across Amazon, Walmart, Target and other retailers, each with different attribution methodologies, reporting structures and optimization environments. Blu Commerce was built to create a common economic view across those investments. By bringing that intelligence into a workflow that connects our Commerce Strategy and Activation teams with Pacvue, we can shorten the distance between understanding what is driving incremental growth and doing something about it."

This connected approach is already delivering results. When Revlon's Mitchum brands needed to close the gap between retail media and commerce operations on Amazon, Horizon Commerce unified its internal platforms with Pacvue's advertising and commerce signals. The results included a 13% average weekly revenue lift, a 19-point improvement in Best Seller Rank (BSR), a 5% lift in paid search revenue, and a 3% lift in paid search conversion rate. By aligning media investment with commerce signals, Revlon and Horizon Commerce shifted from reactive adjustments to proactive growth, powered by automation, actionable insights, and the integrated capabilities of Pacvue's Commerce Operating System.

"Horizon Commerce has been a valued partner since 2022, and this expansion reflects how that relationship has grown," said Melissa Burdick, Co-founder and President of Pacvue. "With more touchpoints across the customer journey than ever, measurement and activation must keep pace with how complex investment decisions have become. Pacvue empowers agency teams with the insight and activation to execute faster, while preserving the flexibility to evaluate performance against the business outcomes that matter to each brand."

The partnership reflects Horizon's broader approach to commerce technology: building an open intelligence layer that connects data, decisioning and activation rather than requiring marketers to operate within a closed technology ecosystem. Together, Horizon Commerce and Pacvue are creating a more connected commerce investment workflow, combining Blu Commerce's cross-retailer measurement, iROI, scenario planning and investment intelligence with scaled activation through Pacvue. The result is a clearer path to shifting dollars toward the highest-value opportunities, reducing inefficient spend and driving greater incremental sales.

ABOUT HORIZON COMMERCE

Horizon Commerce is Horizon Media Holdings' commerce and digital experience agency, helping brands connect media, commerce, data, and technology to drive measurable growth. As a fiercely independent growth partner, the agency combines human expertise, open technology ecosystems, and transparent intelligence to help brands make better investment decisions and create more connected customer experiences across DTC, retail, marketplaces, social, and omnichannel environments. 

At the center of its offering is Blu Commerce, Horizon Commerce's proprietary commerce intelligence platform, which creates a standardized view of performance across retailers, products, and media tactics. Blu Commerce connects measurement, scenario planning, forecasting, and optimization to help marketers understand what is driving incremental growth, identify future investment opportunities, and move from insight to action faster.

ABOUT PACVUE

Pacvue is the leading Commerce Media OS, powering over $12B in advertising spend across 100+ global retail media networks including Amazon, Walmart, Target, Kroger, Instacart, Criteo, and CitrusAd. Powered by industry-leading AI and real-time data, Pacvue enables over 70,000 brands and agencies to maximize advertising performance, drive incrementality, and expand reach across the commerce universe from a single mission control. As of 2025, Pacvue powers 12% of total retail media ad spend worldwide excluding China. Combined with Helium 10's SMB solutions, Pacvue delivers the industry's most comprehensive platform for businesses of all sizes. Founded in 2018, Pacvue spans Seattle, Los Angeles, Chicago, New York, Washington D.C., London, Shanghai, and Tokyo. Discover more at pacvue.com.

releases.title: TikTok Partners with BBB National Programs to Strengthen Trust in Digital Advertising
releases.body:
MCLEAN, Va., Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- BBB National Programs, the non-profit home of U.S. independent industry self-regulation, today announced a collaboration between its National Advertising Division and TikTok that will strengthen accountability for advertising on the platform by creating a direct channel for the National Advertising Division to refer potential violations of TikTok's advertising policies for review.

The collaboration represents a proactive step by TikTok, one of the world's leading platforms for digital discovery, creator content, and brand advertising, to connect its advertising standards with independent industry self-regulation. When the National Advertising Division hears a case involving advertising on TikTok, it will be able to share relevant case outcomes directly with TikTok's Ad Experience team for review against the platform's advertising policies.

"Advertising is evolving and accountability needs to keep pace," said Eric D. Reicin, President and CEO, BBB National Programs. "By working with TikTok, one of the world's leading platforms for brand engagement, we are connecting independent advertising review more directly with the platforms where consumers encounter advertising every day. That is good for consumers, good for businesses, and good for trust in digital advertising."

"When people see advertising on our platform, they expect the brands behind it to be accountable," said Francis Stones, Head of Global Brand Safety & Industry Relations, Global Business Solutions, TikTok. "That means making sure the standards we set for advertising are reflected in the content people encounter. Our collaboration with the National Advertising Division is an important step toward bringing independent review and platform accountability closer together and helping create a digital environment people can trust."

BBB National Programs' National Advertising Division has monitored and reviewed national advertising for truthfulness and accuracy since 1971, providing an independent forum for resolving advertising disputes, monitoring the marketplace, supporting fair competition, and strengthening consumer trust. With multiple case choice options, the National Advertising Division can handle certain case types from receipt to resolution in 20 business days or less.

This collaboration demonstrates how platforms can work with established self-regulatory systems to address emerging advertising challenges as quickly as the marketplace evolves.

Learn more about the National Advertising Division here. 

About BBB National Programs: BBB National Programs, a non-profit organization, is the home of U.S. independent industry self-regulation, currently operating more than 20 globally recognized programs that have been helping enhance consumer trust in business for more than 50 years. These programs provide third-party accountability and dispute resolution services that address existing and emerging industry issues, create fair competition for businesses, and a better experience for consumers. BBB National Programs continues to evolve its work and grow its impact by providing business guidance and fostering best practices in advertising, child-and-teen-directed marketing, data privacy, dispute resolution, automobile warranty, technology, and emerging areas. To learn more, visit bbbprograms.org.

About the National Advertising Division: The National Advertising Division (NAD) of BBB National Programs provides independent self-regulation and dispute resolution services, guiding the truthfulness of advertising across the U.S. NAD reviews national advertising in all media and its decisions set consistent standards for advertising truth and accuracy, delivering meaningful protection to consumers and creating fair competition for business.

releases.title: BrandMo Tech Debuts North America's Only Culture First™ AdTech Ecosystem
releases.body:
AI-optimized platform names Toronto as its global headquarters

TORONTO, Sept. 23, 2026 /CNW/ -- BrandMo Tech today debuts as North America's only Culture First™ intelligence-to-activation adtech ecosystem, delivering weekly audience intelligence built on context, identity, and cultural nuance, and names Toronto as its global headquarters.

BrandMo Tech has spent five years proving the model, powering campaigns for Canadian affiliates of global agency holding companies. It now enters its growth phase as culturally diverse communities become Canada's fastest-growing consumer segment -- audiences legacy targeting tools weren't built to recognize.

"As cultural diversity accelerates, cookies disappear, and walled gardens deliver diminishing returns, advertisers are losing more than signals -- they're losing audience understanding," said Pawan Jailkhani, Founder & CEO of BrandMo Tech. "BrandMo Tech was built to solve this problem."

Through its proprietary technology and partnerships with SSPs, DSPs, and premium publishers, BrandMo Tech reduces reliance on cookies and fragmented third-party signals, enabling activation across desktop, mobile, app, CTV, and social inventory.

"To reach today's audiences, advertisers must go beyond language. They require context and nuance that honour culture," added Jailkhani, a two-decade media and adtech veteran who saw Canada as the ideal launching ground: culturally diverse audiences the industry could not reach. "We built culture into every layer of our tech stack so advertisers can reclaim the open internet."

Committed to investing in Canadian partnerships, BrandMo Tech is also expanding its Toronto team over the next 12–24 months.

Key Capabilities:

  • Better Data Recency: Weekly audience intelligence, not quarterly snapshots
  • Single-Platform Orchestration: Unified workflows, frequency, and journey management across CTV, mobile, app, and desktop
  • Culture First™ Intelligence: Culturally modelled signals embedded directly into programmatic workflows
  • Ecosystem Interoperability: Seamless integration with leading SSPs, DSPs, and premium publishers
  • Open Internet Reach: Omnichannel activation beyond walled gardens

Nearly 70% of Canadian newcomers feel a stronger sense of belonging to brands that advertise in their language, while Canada's culturally diverse communities represent 26.5% of the population, projected to reach 38.2% to 43% by 2041.

BrandMo Tech is a Culture First™ AI-optimized global adtech and intelligence company headquartered in Toronto and a proud member of the Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB). Its platform delivers weekly data recency and culturally modelled signals across 44 languages for CTV, mobile, app, and desktop, through any DSP. Learn more at brandmotech.com.
